r13_contract.comparisonModel: IF frame_asymmetrical = true OR frame_web_angle_to_shell_deg < 90, THEN antitripping_support_spacing_mm <= 1300. IF frame_span_m > 4, THEN antitripping_support_scope = 'all regions/all ice classes'. IF frame_span_m <= 4, THEN required scope is all regions for IA Super, bow and midbody for IA, and bow for IB or IC. An alternative arrangement is acceptable only when equivalent_support_status_by_direct_calculation = demonstrated.

test_cases.rationale: Asymmetrical frame with span >4 m has <=1300 mm support spacing in all regions.
Web angle below 90 degrees triggers support; IA Super short frame is supported in all regions.
IA short-frame scope covers bow and midbody.
IB short-frame scope covers the bow region.
Neither asymmetry nor web angle triggers anti-tripping support; 90 degree boundary is non-triggering.
Approved equivalent support demonstrated by direct calculation is accepted as the alternative route.
Support spacing exactly at the 1300 mm maximum is compliant.
Triggered anti-tripping support spacing exceeds 1300 mm.
IA short frame omits required midbody anti-tripping support scope.
IA Super short frame omits the required stern-region support scope.
Frame longer than 4 m is not supported in all regions.
Triggered case is missing anti-tripping support spacing.

benchmark_policy: Source/R13-defined behavioral oracle created without inspecting generated SHACL.
